name: link-page
title: Link page
description: One address for your bio: your face or mark, your name and one line, then a column of big buttons to everything you do, your other places, and your latest few updates. One screen, phone first.

images.purpose: the round picture at the top (112 px, cropped to a circle) and the browser icon: a face or a logo, subject centred; without it the name leads
images.alt_hint: who or what it shows, e.g. Juno Marsh smiling, in a yellow coat
images.prompt: a clear square photo of the person's face, or their logo on a plain ground, centred with room to crop to a circle

images.purpose: the picture when the link is shared
images.prompt: the avatar on the palette's background colour with the name beside it

images.purpose: a picture at the top of an update's own page
images.prompt: a real photo of what the update is about

content.purpose: your name or handle, the big line at the top
one line under the name: what you do
a sentence more, smaller, under that
the buttons, in order, 3-12: label, link, and an optional one-line note. The first one is filled with the accent colour, so put the one that matters most first
social links print as a row of small pills under the buttons; the email goes in the footer
a pill above everything for news that can't wait, e.g. New single out Friday
each stream prints as a short list of its newest three entries (or upcoming events) under the buttons, linking to its pages
cards print as a compact list (name, price or period, a line), e.g. what you sell
a few centred lines near the bottom
the last line, e.g. For bookings, email me

art.ask: Ask for one clear square photo of their face, or their logo.
art.style: A photograph or a flat mark; subject centred with room to be cropped into a circle. Use real photos for real things; never make up pictures of real places, people or food. Illustrated art only for a mark or emblem, in the palette's accent colour.
steps: Get the photo or logo from the person.
Check it: square or near it, subject centred, sharp at 112 px and at 32 px for the icon.
Write the alt text: who or what it shows.
Use real photos for real things; never make up pictures of real places, people or food. Illustrated art only for a mark or emblem, in the palette's accent colour.
Upload it (an https link in site.logo, or photo_upload_link), then call theme_needs: every slot should say filled.
Open every button's link and check it returns a page before you publish.
